## Unused loop iteration variable For loop variable step is not used in the loop body. --- General fix: when a loop iteration variable is unused, replace the loop with logic that either (a) uses the variable meaningfully, or (b) avoids iterating per element if only existence/count matters.

Best fix here (without changing intended behavior message text): compute invalid upload steps once, then push the warning that many times using a counted loop index. This removes the unused step variable and keeps the same number of warning entries as before.

Change region in scripts/configuration-form.mjs:

  • Replace lines around the current invalid-upload loop (line 19–20 area) with:
    • const invalidUploads = uploads.filter(...)
    • for (let i = 0; i < invalidUploads.length; i++) entries.push(...)

No new imports/dependencies/methods are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused variable step.
